relevant_laws.quote: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle, except when necessary to avoid conflict with other traffic or in compliance with law or the directions of a police officer or official traffic-control device, in any of the following places: Alongside or opposite any highway excavation or obstruction when stopping, standing or parking would obstruct traffic.
relevant_laws.relevance_type: direct highway excavation stop, stand or park restriction
relevant_laws.notes: Actual excavation, obstruction and exceptions require original review.
